acceptanceCriteria: No numeric process-group operation, including signal 0, targets a pgid after its leader is reaped; quiescence proof uses a pinned or pre-reap observation.
A test fails on the pre-fix base and passes after.
Linux and Darwin focused tests pass; Linux amd64 is retained NOT_RUN if not run.
body: Found by the V1-1040 lane (claude/v1-1040-lane cc2378cb, base dad48885) on Darwin, 2026-10-09. internal/procgroup proveProcessGroupQuiescent probes kill(-pgid, 0) after the leader has been reaped. After the reap the pgid can be reused, so the probe can observe an unrelated group and report residue or quiescence wrongly. It is a probe, not a kill, so the impact is a false proof result rather than a stray signal. Suspected defect; not reproduced as a wrong result.

title: procgroup proveProcessGroupQuiescent sends a signal-0 numeric group probe after the leader is reaped
